dealSummary: San Francisco-based Chai Discovery, which builds AI models for molecular drug design, raised a $400 million Series C led by Index Ventures, Kleiner Perkins and Sequoia Capital at a $3.8 billion valuation.
leadInvestors: Index Ventures, Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia Capital

dealSummary: LimX Dynamics, a China-based humanoid robotics startup, raised a $200 million round led by IDG Capital, Lens Technology and Stone Venture at a valuation of $2.2 billion.
leadInvestors: IDG Capital, Lens Technology, Stone Venture

dealSummary: India-based ecommerce startup Udaan secured $160 million from investors including Lightspeed and M&G Investments, made up of equity, debt and the conversion of a portion of its outstanding convertible bonds into equity.
leadInvestors: Lightspeed, M&G Investments, made up of equity, debt, the conversion of a portion of its outstanding convertible bonds into equity

dealSummary: Seattle-based BRINC, a developer of drones for public safety and emergency responses, raised a $125 million round led by Motorola Solutions.
TerraFirma, an Austin-based startup that builds semi-autonomous construction robotics, raised a $100 million Series A led by Kleiner Perkins.
Cover Genius, the developer of an insurance platform, raised $100 million from Vista Credit Partners at a $1.9 billion valuation.

company: Open-source AI agent developer Nous Research
dealSummary: Open-source AI agent developer Nous Research is raising a new round led by Robot Ventures at a $1.5 billion valuation, TechCrunch reported.
San Francisco-based Flex, the operator of a private banking platform for high-net-worth business owners, raised a $70 million Series B1 led by Halo Fund.
Draig Therapeutics, which develops treatments for depression and other psychiatric conditions, secured a $65 million Series B led by Deep Track Capital.
InstaLily, which builds AI to automate operations for industrial and enterprise industries, raised a $60 million Series B led by Energize Capital.
Corner Health, which develops AI tools for nurse practitioners looking to open their own practices, received a $25 million Series A led by Oak HC/FT.
Project Q, a Berlin-based defense tech group, raised a €15 million Series A led by Expeditions Fund.
Skalar, a Munich-based startup building an AI-native tax and accounting firm, secured €12 million in combined pre-seed and seed funding led by Headline.
